cards.title: Running totals
cards.body: Start a variable at 0 before the loop and add to it each time round. `total += x` means `total = total + x`.
cards.code:
total = 0
for x in range(1, 5):
    total += x
print(total)

hi.title: Running total
hi.body: Loop se pehle ek variable 0 se shuru karo aur har round mein usme jodte jao. `total += x` ka matlab `total = total + x`.

cards.title: Reading inside a loop
cards.body: Each call to `input()` reads the next line, so calling it inside a loop reads one line per round.

hi.title: Loop ke andar padhna
hi.body: Har baar `input()` agli line padhta hai, isliye loop ke andar call karne par har round mein ek line padhi jaati hai.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: It should add 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 and print 10, but it prints 4. Tap the bug.
cards.code:
for x in range(1, 5):
    total = 0
    total += x
print(total)

bug.fix: Line 2 sets `total` back to 0 every round. Start the total once, before the loop.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Isse 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 jodkar 10 print karna chahiye, par yeh 4 print karta hai. Bug par tap karo.
hi.fix: Line 2 har round mein `total` ko wapas 0 kar deti hai. Total ko loop se pehle ek hi baar shuru karo.

check.question: What does this print?
check.code:
total = 0
for x in range(3):
    total += 2
print(total)
check.explanation: The loop runs 3 times and adds 2 each time: 2 + 2 + 2 = 6.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: Loop 3 baar chalta hai aur har baar 2 jodta hai: 2 + 2 + 2 = 6.

exercise.prompt: The first line is a count N; then N lines follow, each with one whole number. Print their sum.
exercise.promptHi: Pehli line mein count N hai; phir N lines aati hain, har ek mein ek whole number. Unka sum print karo.
exercise.starterCode:
n = int(input())
total = 0
# read n more numbers and add each to total
print(total)
